books.title: Refactoring UI
books.author: Adam Wathan & Steve Schoger
books.description: The most pragmatic guide to designing clean, high-conversion interfaces from a developer and designer perspective.
books.insight: Design with visual hierarchy and intentional spacing before decorative chrome.

books.title: The Design of Everyday Things
books.author: Don Norman
books.description: The definitive bible on cognitive ergonomics, affordances, signifiers, and designing products that humans intuitively understand.
books.insight: When users fail, it is not user error — it is faulty interface design.

books.title: The Elements of Typographic Style
books.author: Robert Bringhurst
books.description: Widely revered as the definitive text on typographic craft, rhythm, proportional scales, and the architecture of the printed page.
books.insight: Typography exists to honor content and guide human comprehension.

books.title: A Philosophy of Software Design
books.author: John Ousterhout
books.description: A masterclass on managing system complexity, modular interfaces, and why shallow modules ruin large systems.
books.insight: Modules should be deep: simple interfaces hiding profound internal power.

books.title: Universal Principles of Design
books.author: William Lidwell et al.
books.description: An authoritative encyclopedia of 125 cognitive, perceptual, and structural laws governing human interaction.
books.insight: Master Fitts' Law, Hick's Law, and progressive disclosure to reduce cognitive load.

books.title: Shape Up
books.author: Ryan Singer (Basecamp)
books.description: A revolutionary framework for product teams: fixed time, variable scope, 6-week cycles, and building with shaped appetites.
books.insight: Never start building until problems are shaped with clear boundaries.

books.title: Inspired: How to Create Tech Products
books.author: Marty Cagan
books.description: The gold standard for product discovery, continuous customer validation, and building empowered product teams.
books.insight: Validate value, usability, feasibility, and viability before writing code.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.description: The definitive exploration of storage engines, distributed consensus, data models, and scalable systems reliability.
books.insight: A designer who understands backend latency and data models designs 10x better products.

books.title: Grid Systems in Graphic Design
books.author: Josef Müller-Brockmann
books.description: The Swiss design masterwork outlining mathematical grid systems for layout, typography, and architectural coherence.
books.insight: The grid is a structural aid, not a straightjacket — it creates rhythm and order.

books.title: Show Your Work!
books.author: Austin Kleon
books.description: A punchy guide to working in public, building a digital garden, and sharing your creative process openly.
books.insight: Become a documentarian of what you do every day; generosity builds lasting influence.

books.title: A Pattern Language
books.author: Christopher Alexander
books.description: The seminal architectural philosophy that directly inspired object-oriented programming, design systems, and modular components.
books.insight: Reusable patterns solve recurring spatial and informational tensions.

books.title: Creativity, Inc.
books.author: Ed Catmull & Amy Wallace
books.description: The Pixar co-founder's masterclass on creative culture, candid feedback (Braintrust), and protecting early fragile ideas.
books.insight: Early drafts are never great; psychological safety allows teams to turn raw ideas into masterpieces.
